# Prázdniny ve Španělsku

> Direct-booking holiday apartment in Santa Pola, Costa Blanca, Spain. Czech-owned. Not a hotel, not an agency.

- Website: https://prazdninyvespanelsku.cz
- Apartment: Residence Santa Pola, C. Venezuela 11, 03130 Santa Pola, Alicante, Spain
- Size: 110 m², 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, up to 8 guests (typically 6–8)
- Distance: about 200 m to Playa Levante; about 15 minutes from Alicante–Elche airport (ALC)
- Floor: 3rd floor, building without a lift
- Licence: Comunitat Valenciana VT-502018-A
- Contact: info@prazdninyvespanelsku.cz
- Languages of the site: Czech (default), English, Spanish, German, French
- Social: https://www.instagram.com/prazdninyvespanelsku.cz/ · https://www.facebook.com/prazdninyvespanelsku.cz/ · https://www.youtube.com/@prazdninyvespanelsku

## Booking

- Enquire on /rezervace (or /en/rezervace, /es/rezervace, /de/rezervace, /fr/rezervace). Occupancy is confirmed by the owner, then a 50 % Stripe deposit link is sent. Balance is due 30 days before arrival.
- Check-in from 16:00, check-out by 11:00. Keys and a walkthrough by a local caretaker (EN, ES, NL).
- Minimum stay 3–5 nights depending on month. Final cleaning 110 EUR. Optional airport transfer with a Czech-speaking driver 30 EUR (one way, max 4 people). 10 % discount from 30 nights.
- Nightly rates (EUR, excluding cleaning): Nov–Feb 70; Mar–Apr 80; May 95; Jun 140; Jul–Aug 185; Sep 110; Oct 80.
- Cancellation: 60 days 25 %, 30 days 50 %, 21 days 100 % of the stay.
